task.title: Follow setting and documentation links
task.shortdesc: Open focused editor locations or the exact documentation topic for a supported policy or known managed preference.

prereq.p: Open All settings or another BPM surface that links to a setting.

context.p: Editor deep links focus a setting or raw location. In All settings, the separate circled-information control opens manifest-resolved documentation for every supported policy and known managed preference.

step.cmd: For a supported policy or known managed preference, activate the circled-information control beside its row.

info.p: Expected result: the localized documentation opens in a new tab without selecting the row or changing profile data.

step.cmd: Confirm the documentation destination and active tree item.

info.p: Expected result: the tree expands from Documents through the owning guide and section to the exact topic, which is visible and active.

step.cmd: Return to BPM and use an editor or search deep link when you need to change the setting.

info.p: Expected result: the correct editor opens with the relevant setting, review state, raw key, or JSON location focused.

step.cmd: Return to the previous surface only after saving or discarding changes deliberately.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: Documentation links and editor deep links open their exact destinations while preserving orientation.

postreq.p: Recovery: unknown raw settings and missing, stale, incompatible, or unavailable documentation show a localized noninteractive state. Open Documentation from the BPM header and search by exact policy ID or preference key instead of treating that state as a broken link.
